Let
\[
a=x+\frac1{2y},\qquad b=y+\frac1{2x}.
\]
Then
\[
a^2+b^2\ge 2ab.
\]
So
\[
E\ge 2\left(x+\frac1{2y}\right)\left(y+\frac1{2x}\right).
\]
Expanding,
\[
\left(x+\frac1{2y}\right)\left(y+\frac1{2x}\right)
=xy+\frac12+\frac12+\frac1{4xy}
=xy+1+\frac1{4xy}.
\]
Thus
\[
E\ge 2xy+2+\frac1{2xy}.
\]
Let \(t=xy>0\). Then
\[
2t+\frac1{2t}\ge 2,
\]
so
\[
E\ge 4.
\]
Equality occurs at \(x=y=\frac1{\sqrt2}\). Therefore the minimum value is
\[
\boxed{4}.
\]
